notes: «وَ سَأَلَهُ سَمَاعَةُ» names only the asker; the one asked is a pronoun, so the Imam comes from prev1 (3867).
prev1's chain_text ends at سعيد بن يسار; the Imam is named in prev1's own words («سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ», in its text_head), so the inherited surface is taken from there.
The saying («لاَ بَأْسَ بِذَلِكَ») is the Imam's answer.
